Why Friendswood businesses miss calls

Friendswood sits near Clear Lake and Johnson Space Center, and manufacturing employs nearly 15% of workers, one of the higher shares among the Texas cities we cover. Median household income is about $127,000. The area knows flooding well, including Harvey in 2017, so homeowners take water, roofing and repair problems seriously. When something goes wrong, they want an answer right away rather than a callback tomorrow.

Which Friendswood businesses benefit most?

  • Roofing companies: Storm calls can arrive all at once.
  • HVAC and contractors: Gulf heat makes AC problems urgent.
  • Dental offices: Families can book after work.

AI receptionist: Marks it urgent, gets the address and alerts your on-call crew.

Can you keep your Friendswood phone number?

Yes. Friendswood callers will usually see the 281, 346, 713 and 832 area codes, and you can keep the number customers already know. Forward it to the AI for all calls, only after hours, or only when your team does not pick up. We can also set up a new local number. Everything is set up remotely, so you do not need new equipment or a visit to an office.

What to check before you go live

  1. Test real calls: ask awkward questions, not only easy ones, and listen to how it handles them.
  2. Set the rules: decide which calls transfer to a person and which become messages.
  3. Plan your minutes: estimate your busiest month, not an average one.
  4. Tell callers what you need to: Texas is generally treated as a one-party consent state for recording calls, but rules differ for callers in other states, so check with your advisor if you record calls.
